Arquivos criados e validados: [answer.json](answer.json) e [report.md](report.md).

**Gama** foi escolhido por **R$ 31.800,00 em 12 meses**, vencendo o empate com Épsilon pela implantação em 18 dias, contra 19.

Os dois subagentes concluíram suas análises. Os arquivos de entrada foram preservados.

Eligibility: Alfa, Épsilon, Gama, in Portuguese alphabetical order.

Violations: Alfa `[]`; Beta `["R1"]`; Delta `["R2"]`; Épsilon `[]`; Gama `[]`.

Alfa’s exact 48-hour export and 20-day implementation satisfy the bounds. Beta’s Chile backups fail R1. Delta’s signed PDF-only condition and undated future JSON promise fail R2 despite the commercial claim.

Gama wins: R$31,800, tied with Épsilon, but implementation takes 18 versus 19 days. Alfa costs R$32,800; exceeding the desirable budget does not disqualify it.

Winner: **Gama**, total **3,180,000 cents (R$ 31.800,00)**. It passes all mandatory requirements and wins the cost tie with Épsilon through its shorter implementation: 18 versus 19 days.

| Vendor | Total cents | Eligible |
|---|---:|---|
| Alfa | 3,280,000 | Yes |
| Beta | 2,120,000 | No: R1 |
| Gama | 3,180,000 | Yes |
| Delta | 2,260,000 | No: R2 |
| Épsilon | 3,180,000 | Yes |

Full formulas and caveats sent by message. No files modified.
